answer_1.quote: We present the first largescale study of OUD-related myths on YouTube, constructing datasets and evaluating LLMs for myth detection rather than text generation.

answer_2.quote: MYTH-TRIAGE achieves strong performance across myths (0.68-0.86 macro F1-scores; median 0.81) and GPT-4o achieved macro F1-scores between 0.82-0.87.

answer_3.quote: We used an LLM-as-a-judge prompt to determine a video's overall stance on OUD-related myths when both supporting and opposing labels were present.

answer_4.quote: Six clinical researchers ... independently annotated 20 videos ... Krippendorff's α score of 0.76 for all annotations across 310 videos, using detailed annotation guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed a two‑step annotation process with label definitions and were required to provide brief justification excerpts.
